description: Manually vendored JavaScript libraries without a package.json entry. Single source for the license guard (scripts/verify_vendor_js_sync.py), the advisory gate (scripts/audit_vendored_js.py) and the release SBOM. The version must match the banner of the shipped file; sha256 is the hash of the complete shipped file. scope is the CycloneDX scope in the SBOM: required = loaded by production pages, optional = shipped but only used by the test suite.
